_comment: Curated corpus of publicly-available Soroban contracts deployed on Stellar mainnet. Each entry is read-only — the fork test never submits a transaction. Entries are sorted by contract category. Contract IDs refreshed and verified live on 2026-08-28 (now correctly 56-character mainnet strkeys).

corpus.name: Stellar XLM Wrapped Token (WASM)
corpus.description: Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) instance for the native XLM asset on Soroban mainnet (wrapped XLM).

corpus.name: Soroswap AMM Router
corpus.description: Soroswap decentralised-exchange router — complex generic patterns, multi-hop swap paths.

corpus.name: Soroswap Pair (Liquidity Pool)
corpus.description: Individual Soroswap liquidity-pair contract. Tests arithmetic patterns under AMM invariant code.

corpus.name: Blend Protocol Pool Factory
corpus.description: Blend lending-protocol pool factory. Large codebase with complex generics and upgrade paths.

corpus.name: Blend Protocol Backstop
corpus.description: Blend backstop contract — critical risk-management logic with complex time-weighted accounting.

corpus.name: Aqua Constant-Product AMM
corpus.description: Aqua Protocol AMM router managing constant-product pools. Tests invariant arithmetic patterns at scale.

corpus.name: Phoenix Protocol Multi-hop Router
corpus.description: Multi-protocol multi-hop routing contract (execute_route across Phoenix, Soroswap and Aquarius pools).

corpus.name: Comet Weighted AMM Pool
corpus.description: Comet Protocol Balancer-style weighted AMM pool (BLND:USDC 80:20 LP). Tests complex fixed-point math patterns.
